content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Kenya, traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-guide-5|Everything About]]-you-need-3|payment]] platforms often restrict access to digital commerce. This leaves [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-how-bangladeshi-freelancers-accept-international-2|COREMERCH guide to creator]]s unable to monetize their content efficiently. COREMERCH offers a powerful solution with Cloudflare Pages, designed to deploy your digital store rapidly without relying on Stripe or PayPal. This guide will walk you through deploying a robust digital store infrastructure that is entirely sovereign and operational in no time.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment systems such as Stripe and PayPal often fail creators in emerging markets due to restrictions and limited access. COREMERCH addresses these challenges by providing a digital commerce stack that combines decentralized payment processing with full control over your data. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you ensure that your store is not only functional but also resilient against the failures of centralized platforms. This architecture empowers you to serve your customers directly, maintain complete ownership of your assets, and operate independently of traditional banking systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To prepare for deployment, gather the essential elements required for your digital store. You will need a Cloudflare account, where you will set up your Pages for hosting. Familiarity with Google Apps Script is necessary for backend logic, and a NOWPayments account will facilitate your crypto transactions. Additionally, ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, whether they are ebooks, courses, or software. With these resources in hand, you can effectively set up a seamless shopping experience for your customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your backend services through Google Apps Script, ensuring that your logic handles product retrieval and payment confirmation efficiently. Configure your NOWPayments account to accept a variety of cryptocurrencies with low fees, ensuring transactions are smooth and cost-effective. After setting up the payment layer, integrate your digital products into Cloudflare Pages for instant delivery upon purchase. This pipeline not only ensures that your customers receive their purchases immediately but also enhances user experience by simplifying the payment process.
Empower your commerce with infrastructure that you own, not rent.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is established, it’s time to go live. Conduct thorough testing to ensure that every component works seamlessly. After testing on the mainnet, promote your digital store across social media and relevant platforms, directing potential customers to your store link. Monitor the first few transactions closely to address any issues that may arise swiftly. Your store's launch is a pivotal moment; ensure that you communicate effectively with customers and provide support as needed.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store gains traction, consider scaling up your offerings. Utilize the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH to increase your product capacity and improve performance. This stack, deployed in 48 hours, includes comprehensive configurations such as SPF/DKIM/DMARC, enhancing security and deliverability of your emails. Regularly analyze your sales data to identify popular products and optimize your marketing strategies. Scaling effectively will allow you to reach a broader audience and maximize your revenue potential.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Instantly deliver digital products with automated payment verification.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

You can build a digital store by using Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This combination allows for a fully functional store without the need for conventional payment processors.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 is more robust, allowing for more products and features, and is deployed in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting a digital product store. They provide free hosting and have the necessary infrastructure to support your digital sales.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Deploying Stack 01 typically takes between 4 to 6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, allowing you to get your store up and running quickly.
What kind of support can I expect after deployment?
You receive 30-day support post-deployment, ensuring that you have assistance during the initial stages of operating your digital store.
